login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Administrator access to A&A Motors CRM

password.title: Change password
password.description: Use at least 10 characters. You will stay signed in.
password.required: Please replace the initial password before continuing.

settings.title: Business settings
settings.description: Company details used in notifications, templates and the interface.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG up to 2 MB
settings.integrationsNote: Provider credentials are configured through environment variables on the server, never in the browser. See docs/messaging-integrations.md.

quickAdvertising.title: Quick Advertising
quickAdvertising.description: Compose an advertising message with an image, pick one or more customers and send it through the official messaging channels in priority order: WhatsApp, Viber Business Messages, Telegram, Viber Bot. Optionally attach the customer's latest service history.
quickAdvertising.empty: The advertising composer will appear here.

vehicles.title: Vehicle Cards and Service History
vehicles.description: Register vehicles by brand, VIN and plate, record every service visit with oil, oil-filter, cabin-filter and air-filter details, and browse the full history of each car.
vehicles.empty: No vehicles yet. Vehicle cards will be managed here.

referrals.title: Referral Bonuses
referrals.description: Track who invited whom. When an invited customer completes their first paid service, the referrer earns a one-time 10% discount that can be redeemed once.
referrals.empty: Referral tracking and analytics will appear here.

vehicleReady.title: Vehicle Ready SMS
vehicleReady.description: Mark a vehicle as ready for pickup and automatically notify the customer by SMS in Armenian or English, with full delivery history and manual resend.
vehicleReady.empty: Service orders and SMS history will appear here.

campaigns.title: Advertising Campaigns
campaigns.description: Plan scheduled bulk campaigns, segment customers by vehicle and service data, and follow attempted, accepted and confirmed deliveries per channel.

validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number in international format, e.g. +37494889881

preview.fallbackInfo: Channels are tried one at a time in this order: WhatsApp → Viber Business → Telegram → Viber Bot. Only one channel is used per recipient; the next is tried only after a conclusive failure, never while a result is uncertain.

result.description: Delivery progress per recipient. “Accepted by provider” is not a delivery confirmation.

review.continueFallbackHint: Re-queues the delivery starting from the next channel in order.
